findings.message:
URL query contents are rewritten as closing directives

The added `:\s*` branch matches keywords embedded in URL queries. For example, `https://example.test/?x=fixes:#123` becomes `https://example.test/?x=#123`, violating the function's byte-preservation contract and potentially breaking links. Matching should account for URL/Markdown contexts.

src/github/text.ts:12-12

summary: The sanitizer can corrupt non-closing URLs.
